scenario: Match operator `~` per LREG.1.2 — `s ~ /pattern/` in a `where` clause; activation continues iff the pattern matches `s`. Pin: a basic `where m.text ~ /^abc/` against a String slot compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule trig:
    Msg m where m.text ~ /^abc/
->
    log info "x"
